production_path_audit.ranker: winter_agent_v2/runtime.py::LiveRuntime.run calls GoalLibrary.rank for production goal selection
production_path_audit.clock_priority: LiveRuntime passes per-role event readiness bonuses into GoalLibrary.rank only for a live actionable goal with a matching event_id, this runtime's role_id, and an existing RuleBrain route; PARTICIPATE_BEAR still lacks that route and is not promoted as executable
production_path_audit.current_result: Production rank integration is present in source. No learning/timed_event_schedule.json exists, so it has no live reservation to act on; no activity window or real-world promotion is claimed
production_path_audit.generic_event_fallback: A live, identified minimum-guarantee event on Page.EVENT with no dedicated skill is now ranked onto route EVENT, which reuses TRY_ORDINARY_CONTROL with its existing current-frame target screening and two-attempt run bound; this does not prove scoring progress or reward claims
production_path_audit.pre_open_gate: A positive LIVE_CLIENT seconds_to_start keeps EVENT_MINIMUM_GUARANTEE at SCHEDULED_NOT_OPEN and suppresses TRY_ORDINARY_CONTROL, including for a newly observed event id
production_path_audit.reservation_and_window_state: 预约时钟(reserved_start)与实时窗口(live_window_state)分开；正向客户端距开始倒计时可更新预约；当前画面无可读倒计时只将本角色 live_window_state 更新为 UNKNOWN，不删除其他可信预约，也不推断活动已开放。到点唤醒后仍需当前客户端窗口证据才可派发活动动作。
production_path_audit.offline_test_evidence: 247 passed and 24 subtests passed across the focused event, runtime handoff, GoalLibrary, ranking, page-exit, and control-panel regression set; this is offline evidence, not live activity execution
production_path_audit.control_panel_reload: learning/CONTROL_PLANE_RELOAD_REQUIRED.json requests a safe reload; AUTO was active during this audit, so no reload was attempted

preparation_timeline.T-30m: 确认预约、设备、角色、预设、队列和执行链
preparation_timeline.T-15m: 提前处理必要队列，检查导航及角色切换
preparation_timeline.T-5m: 正确角色 READY，普通任务安全让位
preparation_timeline.T-1m: 轻量观察倒计时，禁止长时间开发与巡检
preparation_timeline.OPEN: 立即进入车头或车身执行链
preparation_timeline.DURING: 持续参与或按队伍状态等待下一次机会
preparation_timeline.END: 停止本次执行，保存结果并恢复日常

multi_role_arbitration: 角色 A 已成功参战、角色 B 即将错过首次参与 → 优先保障角色 B 首次参与
角色 A 等待集结出发或部队返回 → 符合切换条件时可安排角色 B
两窗口真实重叠 → 按真实可操作时间安排，不得假装同一设备能同时执行两个账号
never_invent: 不得用推算或社区资料填写 start/end
不得把『当前看不到入口』理解为『未来没有这个任务』
不得把 readiness 的 false 写成 true
